subjects.UNIT:FIGHTER: Subject: Fighter, a basic sword warrior: rounded light steel-grey helmet with a big bright red crest, oversized light steel short sword held up in the right hand, big round shield of pale sandy-tan wood with a light grey steel rim and boss on the left arm, bright red tunic covering the torso, cream-white sleeves and gloves, dark slate-grey belt and boots.
subjects.UNIT:GUARD: Subject: Guard, a chunky cute heavy spearman with a very big head (about half of the figure's height) and a tiny sturdy body in a wide braced stance: a heavy round light steel-grey helmet with a wide brim and a nose guard, a huge tall rectangular tower shield painted solid bright red with a thick light steel border held in front of the body on the left arm, covering him from chin to shins, and a long spear with a pale yellow wooden shaft and a light steel point held upright in the right hand, the point high above the helmet; light grey gloves, dark slate-grey boots; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a wall of shield, not a sword fighter.
subjects.SITE:VILLAGE: Subject: a tiny neutral village that belongs to no one: two or three small cottages with cream plaster walls, light tan timber beams and golden-yellow straw thatched roofs, a short light wooden fence; no flag, no banner, no stone tower, no wall, and no red anywhere.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:FARM: Subject: Farm, one small chunky farmstead: a small barn with cream plaster walls, pale birch timber framing and a golden straw thatched roof, beside a neat square field of golden wheat in rows with a short pale birch fence around it and one small round haystack; wide and chunky, filling the whole width of the image. Buildings only.
